name: miragen-memory
description: Join this Claude Code session to the miragen memory bridge: context injected at start, prompts/outcomes captured, episodes filed as Loimi artifacts, memory_* and store_* tools via MCP.

daemon_url.title: miragend URL
daemon_url.description: Base URL of the hosted miragend bridge (no trailing slash), e.g. https://memory.muutto365.fi

token.title: Bridge bearer token
token.description: MIRAGEND_TOKEN of that daemon, sent as Authorization: Bearer on hooks and MCP calls. Leave empty where a prompt is impossible (cloud environments): the hooks then read MIRAGEND_TOKEN from the session environment.
